name: Vectorized greedy + threshold replication
tagline: Batch-vectorized LPT bin-packing on GPU plus a binary-search water-filling step that picks replica counts before greedy refinement.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces greedy baseline's Python item-loop in balanced_packing with a vectorized argmin-of-masked-loads, and replaces sequential per-replica greedy in replicate_experts with binary-search water-filling plus a tiny greedy refinement; preserves DeepSeek's 3-stage hierarchical structure.

name: Greedy LPT + locality-aware node packing
tagline: Vectorized LPT replaces stage-3 greedy bin-packing inside nodes; for stage-2 replicas a streaming locality-preserving pass keeps same-expert replicas together.
diff_from_baseline: Beyond the greedy/zigzag baselines, restructures rebalance_experts to first replicate then group same-expert replicas contiguously and place them while monitoring per-node load against an ideal-load slack — explicitly trading a tiny bit of balance for cluster-wide expert locality.

name: Multi-start serpentine + capped water-fill
tagline: Tensor-only serpentine bin-packing over a small bank of patterns and shifts (no batch loop), plus an expert-specific replica cap derived from sqrt(w/mean).

key_hyperparams.name: shift_set
key_hyperparams.role: candidate cyclic shifts in serpentine packing

diff_from_baseline: Vectorizes packing as a multi-pattern serpentine search (extends the zigzag baseline) and replaces uncapped greedy replication with a square-root-law cap that limits per-expert replicas — both designed to cap heavy-tail blow-up on the stress regime.

name: Vectorized LPT, expert-level node split
tagline: Batch-vectorized LPT replaces the per-batch Python loop everywhere; in stage 1 packs individual experts (rather than groups) directly to nodes.
diff_from_baseline: Same Python-loop greedy LPT as baseline but vectorized across batch dimension; differs structurally by dropping the group-level pre-packing step (stage 1 packs experts, not groups), so num_groups is effectively unused.

name: Greedy LPT + proportional replication
tagline: Standard LPT for packing, but allocates extra replicas in proportion to expert weight via floor-then-largest-fractional water-filling.
diff_from_baseline: Keeps DeepSeek's hierarchical scaffold but swaps greedy max-load replication for a proportional largest-remainder allocator that distributes extras in one shot rather than O(extra) argmax steps; balanced_packing remains the original Python-loop LPT.
